central_question: Which overload responses can a small robot's drivetrain handle mechanically, and what still requires feedback control?
claims_and_limits: INSECTRON is 8.7 cm long and 33.9 g, with two motors and six legs; Hall sensors support phase feedback.
Recovery probabilities 0.91, 0.95 and 0.94 are from three controlled vertical perturbation conditions, not arbitrary outdoor impacts.
Speed 2.7 cm/s on the flat reference surface fell to 0.8 cm/s at a 5-degree incline in reported tests.

visual.shared_motif: Terracotta six-legged robot and a magnified magnetic leg connection; the inner illustration shows drive, momentary slip and re-engagement.
visual.status: Conceptual illustration, not a faithful rendering of the laboratory prototype.
